description: Screens a wallet address against every digital-currency address on the US Treasury OFAC SDN list (ETH, BTC, TRON, USDT, USDC, SOL, ARB, BSC, LTC, XMR). Run before sending or accepting funds. 0.002 USDC per call via x402.

paymentProof.description: Payment proof: USDC tx hash on Polygon or Base (0x...) or Solana tx signature. Omit on the first call to receive the 402 payment instructions, pay, then call again with the proof.

name: sanctions_check
